posts.title: Beyond the Cosmic Horizon: Unveiling the Mysteries of Exoplanet Atmospheres
posts.excerpt: We aren't just counting exoplanets anymore — we are decoding the chemical makeup of their skies. Here is how scientists read the invisible air of worlds hundreds of light-years away.

posts.title: Cosmic Enigma: Unraveling the Dark Energy Mystery That's Rewriting the Universe
posts.excerpt: For most of the 20th century, astrophysicists were certain the universe's expansion was slowing down. Then the data came back — and we were entirely wrong.
